current, KA (RMS)

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Overhaul of Breaking Chamber
Porcelain lift off, contacts and PTFE- parts replaced with new ones.
Major Overhaul of Complete Circuit Breaker and Operating Mechanism

items:
Disassembly of the poles and mechanisms, new contacts and PTFE-components are 
 to be mounted.
Exchange of outer worn out parts.

If the circuit-breaker and operating mechanism are overhauled for another 
 2,000 operations, selected worn out parts are to be exchanged.

If the circuit breaker and operating mechanism are overhauled for another 
 10,000 operations, in principle all moving parts to be exchanged.

Tools and Equipment

 helmet, safety shoes, safety harnesses

Electronic timer.

Work to be Carried Out
Overhaul of Breaking Chamber

If the circuit-breaker and operating mechanism are overhauled for another 
 2,000 operations, selected worn out parts are to be exchanged.
If the circuit breaker and operating mechanism are overhauled for another 
 10,000 operations, in principle all moving parts to be exchanged.
